context.body: The bounded canonical source is Exodus 40:34–38; its local speaker, audience, sequence, and literary form remain controlling evidence.
context.label: Narrative or literary frame

observations.body: The cloud covers the tent, glory fills the tabernacle, and even Moses cannot enter.
observations.label: Glory fills the dwelling and guides Israel: action

observations.body: Israel moves only when the cloud lifts, with fire visible at night.
observations.label: Glory fills the dwelling and guides Israel: response

payload.posture: Read Exodus 40:34–38 as covenant at the mountain evidence before carrying it into another source.
payload.tension: The sign of divine presence is also a barrier and a schedule that the people do not control.
payload.title: Glory fills the dwelling and guides Israel
